nodes.label: Goal100 seed-11 research20k training — 2026-11-11
nodes.status: 20,000 transitions completed; job failed raw QC
nodes.summary: One real Gazebo learning run with seed 11: replay 20,000, critic updates 10,000, actor updates 5,000. Goal100 100D/1D at 10 Hz; common residual ±0.02 m/s through projection and velocity PI. MLP 256×256, LR 0.0003, batch 256, replay capacity 100k, warmup 10k, delay 2. Three development layouts alternate; validation/test unused.
nodes.rationale: Completing optimization and replay does not imply measurement acceptance or frozen-policy advantage.

nodes.label: Goal100 exploratory training outcomes
nodes.summary: 126 completed episodes: 113 successes, six path violations and seven stalls; 134 final transitions remain censored. Clear/early/late successes were 42/42, 34/42 and 37/42. No monotonic success/return improvement appeared across 5k-step groups.
nodes.rationale: The 89.68% rate describes changing policies with exploration. It is neither a frozen benchmark nor causal evidence of learning benefit; censored steps stay outside the success/failure denominator.

nodes.label: Episode 57 drive-source gap and raw QC failure
nodes.status: Raw QC FAIL; 40 ms threshold unchanged
nodes.summary: Re-reading all 127 raw episodes reproduced the original failure: dev_early episode 57 drive timestamps jump 2.562→2.616 s, a 54 ms gap approximately 0.256 s after task start, during zero-reference warmup. Episode eventually succeeded. Session maximum gaps: wheel 9 ms, IMU/truth 20 ms, drive 54 ms; maximum drive age at policy decisions 28 ms.
nodes.rationale: Raw continuity and decision freshness answer different questions. The gap alone did not establish loss of motor control; excluding the episode or trimming warmup after observing results would not repair the original failed job.

nodes.label: Goal100 full replay and action-semantics audit
nodes.summary: All 20,000 replay rows matched observations, next observations, requested actions, rewards and terminal/timeout fields within 2e-6; reward components summed correctly, arrays were finite and no privileged-truth guidance was detected. Requested versus accepted action differed in 81.07% of steps, including warmup/ramp/filtering; this is not the fraction blocked. Torque limiting was a simulation diagnostic.
nodes.rationale: Requested, projected and executed references must remain distinct; simulated execution is not physical motor execution evidence.

nodes.label: 2026-11-12 training storage retention
nodes.summary: Freed 3.779 GiB by deleting 327 listed files including six checkpoint bundles. Deleted 297 large raw files from 99 successful QC-valid Goal100 episodes; retained raw from 28 selected episodes, all failures, episode-57 QC evidence and censored data. Kept Goal100 10k/15k/20k-final model, replay and identity; removed redundant/prelearning bundles with metadata/hash receipts. Training traces, evidence, real data and 238-file short qualification retained.
nodes.rationale: Original manifests and job states stay unchanged. The deliberately failure-enriched retained raw subset cannot estimate success rate or validate the complete original raw archive.
